author: iTrolling
body:
Hello there Avicus community,

This server is 1 of the most amazing servers ever that I've played among 2010, I also would like to state that I usually spend an average of 1 hour every time I join this server but unfortunately I've been accused for flying and got banned on June. 03. 2016 5:24:02 PM GMT by by DeleciousShoesHD by an error .. and what I'm trying to say is I'd really want to get back on board because I never did anything wrong. On top of that I've been playing on this server for about 2 years and this is my first ban ever which I totally believe is an error.

Hoping to hear from you soon,

Thanks,

- Pistolmpp
